_comment: What collect.sample() returns for one registry: a run_query payload with every in-scope
feature merged on as a column. Row a2 carries a cell_type outside the feature's permitted
values, row a3 an n_cells that is not a number, and row a5 a legitimately multi-valued
cell. Row a4 carries nothing, which is data rather than a defect. Row a6 is the pair of
cells nothing can judge: a permitted value that itself contains the join separator, next
to a multi-valued numeric cell. Both are correct and neither can be decomposed.
roi_uid is free text, so both cells are judged and neither can be refused. annotations is
categorical with no permitted value landed against it, which is a thin declaration rather
than a bad row, so both of its cells go unjudged for a reason of their own.
A frame carrying no uid. lamin_api merges feature columns by uid, so _apply_merge returns
the frame unchanged and no feature column reaches it, while the payload still names the
feature it was asked to merge. Nothing here can be judged, and the panel has to say that
rather than report a clean result over a sample it never looked at.
